title: Acoustic behaviour of the grey kangaroo
creator_credit: Ross Christopher and Australian National University
brief_description: Looks at the work done at the Acoustic Laboratory of the research School of Biological Sciences at the Australian National University on senses in kangaroos. Shows the environment of the kangaroo and how its hearing is used in cooperation with its eyes for scanning.
